children: Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said he doesn't think fighting inflation will come at the cost of higher unemployment. Unemployment is currently "basically consistent" with full employment, he said. "I don't believe we need to do harm to the labor market to achieve our objective," he added.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
